"This chart, titled "**Overall Deficit (Cumulative, percent of GDP)**," tracks the monthly cumulative fiscal deficit as a percentage of GDP for the years 2021, 2022, 2023, and the beginning of 2024.

### Chart Components
*   **Vertical Axis (Y-axis):** Percent of GDP, ranging from **-1** to **6**.
*   **Horizontal Axis (X-axis):** Calendar months from **Jan** to **Dec**.
*   **Legend:** 
    *   **2021** (Gray line)
    *   **2022** (Light blue line)
    *   **2023** (Medium blue line)
    *   **2024** (Dark blue line)

### Data Observations
The years 2021 through 2023 show a consistent upward trend, indicating an increasing cumulative deficit throughout the year. In contrast, the available data for 2024 (January through April) shows a cumulative surplus (negative deficit).

| Month | 2021 (Gray) | 2022 (Light Blue) | 2023 (Blue) | 2024 (Dark Blue) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Jan** | ~0.0 | ~0.2 | ~0.3 | ~-0.1 |
| **Feb** | ~0.2 | ~0.4 | ~0.6 | ~-0.15 |
| **Mar** | ~0.4 | ~0.6 | ~0.8 | ~-0.2 |
| **Apr** | ~0.5 | ~0.7 | ~1.0 | ~-0.2 |
| **May** | ~0.7 | ~1.1 | ~1.3 | - |
| **Jun** | ~1.1 | ~1.6 | ~1.7 | - |
| **Jul** | ~1.5 | ~1.8 | ~2.1 | - |
| **Aug** | ~2.0 | ~2.3"
